requirement.original: The interactive trip editor must be a visual upgrade of the published Notion-style travel plan page — same look, with drag-and-drop added. It must NOT be a downgrade or a different design. The published page shows restaurant/activity cards WITH ACTUAL PHOTOS. The editor currently shows text-only cards. This is the gap.
requirement.clarified: Add photo rendering to candidate cards, timeline selected cards, and a city cover image at top of page in the trip editor. Expose images.json via the trip API so the frontend can look up image URLs.
requirement.what: Render venue photos in candidate and timeline cards; render city cover image at top of middle pane; expose images.json data via GET /api/trip/<id>
requirement.why: Editor is a visual downgrade from the published page — published page shows photos, editor shows text only

included: City cover image at top of #tab-timeline
excluded: Anything not directly about photo rendering

success_criteria: Candidate cards show photo thumbnails for venues with image matches
Timeline selected cards show photo thumbnails for selected options with image matches
City cover image visible at top of timeline pane
Cards with no image match show no broken icon (img hidden, src removed)
GET /api/trip/<id> returns images.pois and images.city_covers in response body
constraints: img elements must have draggable=false to avoid drag interference
No-match img: must use removeAttribute('src') not src=''
Server must normalize images.json to {pois, city_covers} only — strip extra keys
images.json absent must return empty dict, not 500
Cover img must be inside #tab-timeline, not in <header> or outside <main>

out_of_scope_observations.observation: TripResponse TypedDict does not declare an 'images' field. Adding images to the API response without updating this contract creates a schema drift. Updating the contract and adding typed test coverage is a separate cycle.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex identified 10 issues with the draft spec; 8 were in-scope real bugs or in-scope minor issues, 1 was out of scope, 1 was already covered. All in-scope findings were applied to this spec.

findings.issue: hydrate_trip() does not specify graceful handling when images.json is absent
findings.proposed_fix: Load with default {pois:{}, city_covers:{}}; missing file must not fail hydration
findings.rationale: M2 in requirements explicitly requires graceful FileNotFoundError fallback; Technical Hints specifies the try/except pattern

findings.issue: Returning full images.json may include extra fields (destination, fallback_unsplash)
findings.proposed_fix: API response images should include only normalized pois and city_covers
findings.rationale: M1 and Technical Hints now specify normalization to {pois, city_covers} only, stripping other keys

findings.issue: Image lookup key not precisely specified; risk of wrong prefix
findings.proposed_fix: Define exact helper using 'gaode_' + opt.name_local; no network fetch, no new fallbacks
findings.rationale: Technical Hints explicitly specifies the lookup key pattern confirmed from images.json read; fallback prefixes forbidden

findings.issue: state.images hydration assignment not explicit in draft
findings.proposed_fix: In _fetchTrip(), set state.images = {pois: data.images?.pois || {}, city_covers: data.images?.city_covers || {}}
findings.rationale: M3 now explicitly requires this assignment pattern verbatim

findings.issue: renderCover() not wired into render lifecycle; stale cover on day switch
findings.proposed_fix: Call renderCover() from renderAll() and derive city via _deriveCityName(_getActiveDay())
findings.rationale: M10 explicitly requires renderCover() called from renderAll(); Edge Case 5 documents the stale-cover risk

findings.issue: Cover img placement 'below header' risks grid layout change
findings.proposed_fix: Place inside existing #tab-timeline at top, not in global header
findings.rationale: M9 now specifies img#trip-cover placed inside #tab-timeline as first child, NOT in header; AC6 verifies no layout regression

findings.issue: img elements are draggable by default; interferes with card drag
findings.proposed_fix: Add draggable=false to all photo img elements
findings.rationale: All img elements in spec now include draggable=false attribute; also in Technical Hints

findings.issue: Hidden/no-image: setting src='' triggers browser network request and may show broken icon
findings.proposed_fix: If no URL: img.hidden = true; img.removeAttribute('src')
findings.rationale: M7 and M8 explicitly require removeAttribute('src') pattern; Edge Case 3 documents this pitfall; AC4 verifies no src attribute is present

findings.issue: CSS step described too broadly; risks inadvertent token or global changes
findings.proposed_fix: Limit CSS to component-local .card-photo / #trip-cover sizing, object-fit, border radius, and hidden behavior
findings.rationale: M11 now explicitly limits CSS to .card-photo and #trip-cover only; explicitly forbids token, grid, and mobile changes

findings.issue: API contract (TripResponse TypedDict) and deterministic tests not updated
findings.proposed_fix: Update TripResponse contract in api_contract.py:77-83 and add tests for images present/missing
findings.rationale: Out of scope per orchestrator's locked scope; logged in out_of_scope_observations for a future cycle

codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Findings 1-9 (all in-scope) applied: graceful fallback (M2), normalization (M1+Hints), exact lookup key (Hints), explicit state.images assignment (M3), renderCover wired to renderAll (M10), cover placement inside #tab-timeline (M9), draggable=false on all imgs (M4/M5/M8/M9), removeAttribute('src') pattern (M7/M8/AC4), CSS limited to component-local (M11). Finding 10 (api_contract schema) logged in out_of_scope_observations.
